blurb: Guests take narrated helicopter flights over Maui's iconic landscapes such as Haleakala Crater, Hana rainforest, West Maui Mountains, and Molokai sea cliffs. Some tours include doors-off experiences and oceanfront landings. Tours range from 45 to 75 minutes, with options for rainforest landings and champagne toasts.
